title: A Novel In-Home Disposal Kit to Mitigate Drug Misuse and Environmental Risk
content: Unused prescription opioids in homes contribute to drug misuse. ICET, Inc. created a disposable, eco-friendly disposal kit that deactivates opioids through catalytic oxidation at room temperature, reducing concentrations by over 99% within two hours. The patented formulation includes permonosulfate, catalysts, and solidifying agents. LC-MS confirmed effective degradation of DEA Schedule I–IV substances. The kit is suitable for home, hospice, and clinical use, addressing public health and environmental concerns by preventing drug diversion and minimizing ecological impact. It also has potential for hormonal, antidepressant, and antibiotic deactivation.
